title: Associativity of the composition isomorphisms of left adjoints
statement:
Let $\mathcal C_0,\mathcal C_1,\mathcal C_2,\mathcal C_3$ be categories and, for each pair $0\le i<j\le 3$, let $L_{ij}:\mathcal C_i\to\mathcal C_j$ be a functor left adjoint to a functor $R_{ji}:\mathcal C_j\to\mathcal C_i$, with unit $\eta_{ij}:\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C_i}\to R_{ji}L_{ij}$. Assume $R_{ki}=R_{ji}\circ R_{kj}$ (equality of functors) for all $0\le i<j<k\le3$. For $i<j<k$, $L_{jk}L_{ij}\dashv R_{ji}R_{kj}=R_{ki}$ is the composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], with unit $R_{ji}(\eta_{jk,L_{ij}M})\circ\eta_{ij,M}$; let $c_{ijk}:L_{jk}L_{ij}\to L_{ik}$ be the unique natural transformation such that
$$R_{ki}(c_{ijk,M})\circ R_{ji}(\eta_{jk,L_{ij}M})\circ\eta_{ij,M}=\eta_{ik,M}\qquad\text{for every object }M\text{ of }\mathcal C_i,$$
which exists and is a natural isomorphism by [lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation] (applied with $L_1=L_{jk}L_{ij}$ and the composite adjunction, $L_2=L_{ik}$, $R_1=R_2=R_{ki}$, $\delta=\mathrm{id}$). Then for every object $M$ of $\mathcal C_0$
$$c_{023,M}\circ L_{23}(c_{012,M})=c_{013,M}\circ c_{123,L_{01}M}\colon L_{23}L_{12}L_{01}M\longrightarrow L_{03}M.$$
